_comment: Every single-task state in statemachine/compute_metrics.asl.json runs THIS task definition -- the adapter step (prepare_metrics_input.py), the 6 wave-2 scripts (06/07/08/09/12/13, which each read one already-merged embeddings .npz and do one vectorized pass over the whole corpus in seconds -- no row-level sharding needed, same reasoning as poster-corpus-validation's 07/08/09), and the merge steps for wave-1's shards. Higher memory than the validator's task-definition.json (3072 -> 6144) because loading a full clip_embeddings.npz/siglip_embeddings.npz for a 145k-poster corpus into a single process, plus pandas merges against the metrics-input CSV, uses meaningfully more RAM than poster-corpus-validation's boto3-only workload ever did.
